The [[UCLA Bruins men's basketball|Bruins]] were led by first year head coach [[Steve Alford]] and played home games at [[Pauley Pavilion]] as members in the [[Pac-12 Conference]]. They finished the season 28–9 and advanced to the Sweet 16 of the [[2014 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]]. UCLA finished 12–6 in Pac-12 play, finishing in second place in the conference. At the [[2014 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]], the Bruins defeated the [[2013–14 Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team|Arizona Wildcats]] 75–71 for the tournament championship. [[Kyle Anderson (basketball)|Kyle Anderson]] was voted the tournament's Most Outstanding Player after scoring 21 points and grabbing 15 rebounds in the championship game. As Pac-12 Tournament champions, the Bruins received an automatic bid to the NCAA Tournament, where they defeated [[2013–14 Tulsa Golden Hurricane men's basketball team|Tulsa]] and [[2013–14 Stephen F. Austin Lumberjacks basketball team|Stephen F. Austin]] to advance to the Sweet Sixteen—their first regional semifinal appearance since [[2007–08 UCLA Bruins men's basketball team|2008]]—where they lost to [[2013–14 Florida Gators men's basketball team|Florida]], who improved to 4–0 all-time against UCLA in the NCAA tournament.{{cite news|title=Gators finish off UCLA for 29th straight win, 4th straight Elite 8|date=March 27, 2014|work=ESPN.com|agency=Associated Press|url=https://www.espn.com/los-angeles/ncb/recap?gameId=400548873|access-date=March 28, 2014}} ==Previous season== {{main|2012–13 UCLA Bruins men's basketball team}} ==Departures== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
